ranking: Sum of 1/sqrt(local rank) across cities with matched labels. Rank is calculated after grouping synonymous source labels. Ties in local counts share rank. Score ties favor broader city coverage, then alphabetical order. Each city contributes at most 1 point to any type.
scope: Available published data. Prefer 2025 where available. Coverage, filters, source label detail, date fields, and volume differ. Excludes unclassifiable labels, generic information and intake entries, explicitly proactive cases, and Denver 911 labels. Denver uses recurring Case_Summary values with at least five records because its other type fields are mostly empty. Published group counts can include repeat reports.
categories: CommonSR's 15 established agency categories, used here as functional request groupings. These labels describe request families and can differ from the responsible agency category.

mapping_decisions.decision: SF bulky-item reports under Street and Sidewalk Cleaning are grouped as Illegal Dumping. Scheduled large-item pickups are Bulk Waste Collection.
Charlotte recyclable and non-recyclable item codes are treated as bulky collection codes.
NYC WATER LEAK is a building leak complaint and is grouped with Residential Plumbing Complaint.
Mixed missed-collection labels with no reliable service split are grouped under Missed Garbage Collection. Explicit recycling, bulk, compost, and yard waste labels are ranked separately.
Seattle's combined Illegal Dumping / Needles label contributes to Illegal Dumping. Explicit sharp or medical waste labels elsewhere contribute to Needle or Medical Waste Pickup.
Sewer Backup or Overflow is categorized as Utilities, which covers sewer and wastewater requests in the existing CommonSR categories.
